---
title: "Demos"
---

A collection of demonstrations of `SimilaritySearch.jl` and related packages, using real and
synthetic datasets. Unlike the package tutorials, these demos use larger datasets and longer
computations to produce richer visualisations.

> **Tip**: run Julia with `-t auto` (or `JULIA_NUM_THREADS=auto`) to enable multithreading in
> all demos.

---

## Synthetic / Geometric

Conceptually simple datasets that make algorithmic behaviour easy to visualise.

- [**2D Synthetic Dataset**](syn2d.qmd) — `SearchGraph` on 100k 2D points; batch search,
  `closestpair`, near-duplicate detection.
- [**Prime Number Factors**](primes.qmd) — Integers as prime-factor sets; Dice distance;
  UMAP; all-kNN recall evaluation.
- [**All-kNN and Center Selection**](allknn-selectors.qmd) — `allknn`, `fft`, `dnet`,
  `randsel`, `multirandsel`, `neardup`; applied to Fashion-MNIST prototypes.

---

## Vision / Images

Demos on image datasets: visual search, near-duplicates, and dimensionality reduction.

- [**MNIST Handwritten Digits**](mnist.qmd) — `SearchGraph` + UMAP; visual kNN search;
  near-duplicate digit detection.

---

## Language / Text

Demos on word embeddings and full-text search.

- [**Wikipedia LSI Word Embeddings**](wikipedia-lsi.qmd) — LSI embeddings from Wikipedia ES/EN;
  synonym search; analogy test; UMAP projection of the lexicon.
- [**Wikipedia BM25 Search**](wikipedia-bm25.qmd) — High-performance full-text BM25 search
  with TextSearch 1.1 Inverted Files and query expansion on 60k Wikipedia paragraphs.
- [**Emoji-Space**](emojispace.qmd) — Tweet embeddings with TextSearch 1.1 TF-IDF; UMAP.

---

## Advanced Operations

Demos of SimilaritySearch operations beyond basic kNN.

- [**Bichromatic Operations**](bichromatic.qmd) — `bichromatic_closestpair`,
  `bichromatic_kclosestpairs`, `bichromatic_metricjoin`; visual 2D example + cross-lingual
  word alignment with Wikipedia embeddings.

---

## Manifold Learning

Using `SimSearchManifoldLearning.jl` with `ManifoldLearning.jl`.

- [**Isomap with ApproxEuclidean**](using-manifoldlearning.qmd) — S-Curve and prime-gap
  time series embedded with Isomap using approximate nearest neighbours.
